title: Rescaled generic trace and conjugation along a commuting square
statement: Let C,D be integral schemes, pi:D -> C, and q:Spec D.functionField -> Spec C.functionField finite etale of degree d, with q followed by eta_C equal to eta_D followed by pi. Let M be an abelian etale sheaf over Spec C.functionField, killed by m, with d coprime to m. If q^* M is isomorphic to N, then eta_C* M is a retract of pi_* eta_D* N. No filtration or curve hypothesis is needed.

proof.text: Apply the prescribed-degree finite etale trace formula to q and M, giving restriction followed by trace equal to d times id M.
Nat.gcd_eq_gcd_ab and coprimality give integer Bezout coefficients. Since m times id M is zero, multiplying trace by gcdA d m makes it a left inverse of restriction.

Apply eta_C lowerStar. Compose the two lowerStarComp isomorphisms using the commuting square and the image of the terminal-sheaf isomorphism. Conjugate both maps by the resulting isomorphism. Functoriality and hom_inv_id prove the retraction identity.
